title: Policy engine: decision validator and staged schema-enforcement for routing DSL
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Refactor the routing policy validator to introduce a decision-level validator that validates semantics (region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants) in addition to shape/schema checks. Goal: prevent unsafe rollouts and misrouted traffic due to config drift while enabling staged schema migration for backward compatibility. The validator should run as part of config CI, in-console preflight checks, and at runtime as a lightweight guardrails mode. Deliverables: typed AST validator, semantic linter rules, compatibility shim that produces migration warnings, a golden-config test harness, and a small property-based fuzzer for constraint regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Typed AST schema validator exists and covers region, tier, and fallback constructs
CI step fails on schema violations and provides actionable messages with PR link suggestions
Console preflight shows warnings and suggested autofixes for deprecated constructs
Runtime guardrails mode rejects configs with safety-critical failures and emits telemetry events
Canary migration plan documented and automation to run staged checks during rollout
